summary: Recent changes to Firefox's image decoding capabilities focus on improving the performance of AVIF images, a modern format that offers high-quality images at smaller file sizes. The adjustments made to the **dav1d** decoder now allow it to scale the number of threads used for decoding based on the actual size of the image rather than just the CPU count. This means that larger images will be processed more efficiently, enhancing loading times and overall user experience when viewing AVIF images. This improvement is vital as AVIF gains popularity for its superior compression capabilities compared to traditional formats like JPEG.
